attacks.title: Credential phishing link delivered
attacks.description: A mailbox associated with {{UserPrincipalName}} received a message containing a credential-harvesting link. Related activity was associated with {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: A phishing link targeting cloud credentials was delivered to a monitored mailbox.
attacks.recommendedActions: Review the message, reset exposed credentials, and block the sender and URL.

attacks.title: Malicious email attachment detected
attacks.description: An attachment delivered to {{UserPrincipalName}} exhibited malicious document behavior and was associated with {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: A weaponized attachment attempted to establish execution through a user-delivered document.
attacks.recommendedActions: Quarantine the message, locate related deliveries, and review recipient activity.

attacks.title: Business email compromise activity
attacks.description: A trusted mailbox displayed anomalous sending behavior followed by access from {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: Compromised account behavior was used to send financially themed messages to internal recipients.
attacks.recommendedActions: Disable active sessions, reset credentials, and review mailbox and payment activity.

attacks.title: Suspicious inbox rule created
attacks.description: A rule was created to hide selected messages in the mailbox used by {{UserPrincipalName}} after activity from {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: A mailbox rule redirected or deleted messages matching attacker-selected criteria.
attacks.recommendedActions: Remove the rule, revoke sessions, and inspect mailbox audit activity.

attacks.title: External mailbox forwarding enabled
attacks.description: Mailbox content for {{UserPrincipalName}} was configured to forward externally following access from {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: An external forwarding configuration created a persistent email exfiltration path.
attacks.recommendedActions: Disable forwarding, review affected messages, and revoke suspicious sessions.

attacks.title: Phishing link sent through Teams
attacks.description: A collaboration message delivered a credential-harvesting link to {{UserPrincipalName}} and was opened from {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: A phishing campaign used a collaboration message rather than email for delivery.
attacks.recommendedActions: Remove the message, block the sender, and review user sign-ins.

attacks.title: Password spray against cloud accounts
attacks.description: A single source attempted a common password across multiple identities, including {{UserPrincipalName}}, with related activity on {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: Distributed authentication failures were consistent with a password-spray campaign.
attacks.recommendedActions: Block the source, enforce MFA, and review successful sign-ins in the same window.

attacks.title: MFA fatigue campaign detected
attacks.description: Repeated MFA prompts targeted {{UserPrincipalName}} before an anomalous approval associated with {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: Repeated authentication prompts indicate an attempt to obtain accidental user approval.
attacks.recommendedActions: Revoke sessions, reset credentials, and require number matching or phishing-resistant MFA.

attacks.title: Authentication token replay observed
attacks.description: A token associated with {{UserPrincipalName}} was reused from inconsistent locations and linked to {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: Session-token reuse bypassed the expected interactive authentication sequence.
attacks.recommendedActions: Revoke refresh tokens, reset credentials, and investigate token theft.

attacks.title: Atypical travel sign-in
attacks.description: Sign-ins for {{UserPrincipalName}} originated from geographically distant locations in an implausible interval and included {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: Atypical travel characteristics may indicate compromised credentials or approved travel infrastructure.
attacks.recommendedActions: Confirm the activity with the user and review device and session details.

attacks.title: Legacy authentication used by privileged account
attacks.description: {{UserPrincipalName}} authenticated through a legacy protocol lacking modern controls, with activity linked to {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: Legacy authentication increased exposure to password-based account compromise.
attacks.recommendedActions: Disable legacy authentication and review the source and application.

attacks.title: Suspicious OAuth consent grant
attacks.description: {{UserPrincipalName}} granted broad permissions to an unfamiliar application from {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: An OAuth application received persistent access to tenant data through delegated consent.
attacks.recommendedActions: Revoke consent, disable the application, and review affected accounts.

attacks.title: Credential added to OAuth application
attacks.description: A new credential was added to an existing application after activity involving {{UserPrincipalName}} and {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: An application credential was added to establish durable tenant access.
attacks.recommendedActions: Remove the credential, rotate application secrets, and audit service-principal activity.

attacks.title: Mass download from cloud storage
attacks.description: {{UserPrincipalName}} downloaded an unusual volume of files from cloud storage using {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: High-volume cloud-file access exceeded the identity's established activity pattern.
attacks.recommendedActions: Review downloaded content, validate business need, and revoke suspicious sessions.

attacks.title: Data transferred to personal cloud storage
attacks.description: Files accessed by {{UserPrincipalName}} on {{DeviceName}} were uploaded to an unsanctioned cloud-storage service.
attacks.summary: Sensitive information was transferred to a personal cloud application.
attacks.recommendedActions: Restrict the destination, preserve evidence, and review the affected data.

attacks.title: Unusual SharePoint file deletion
attacks.description: {{UserPrincipalName}} deleted a large number of SharePoint files during a short session from {{DeviceName}}.
attacks.summary: Bulk deletion activity may indicate destructive behavior or account misuse.
attacks.recommendedActions: Suspend the session, restore content, and validate the activity with the owner.

attacks.title: Encoded PowerShell execution
attacks.description: {{DeviceName}} executed PowerShell with encoded content under the context of {{UserPrincipalName}}.
attacks.summary: Obfuscated PowerShell execution attempted to conceal script behavior.

attacks.title: Rundll32 executed suspicious content

attacks.summary: A trusted Windows binary was used to proxy execution of suspicious code.

attacks.title: Regsvr32 proxy execution detected

attacks.title: Certutil downloaded encoded payload

attacks.title: Suspicious access to LSASS memory

attacks.title: Microsoft Defender exclusion added

attacks.title: Endpoint security service stopped

attacks.summary: Security tooling was impaired before additional suspicious execution occurred.

attacks.title: Suspicious scheduled task created

attacks.summary: A scheduled task established recurring execution of suspicious content.
